capabilities: Compare named brace and printf tokens between source and target notes line by line
Report missing, added, renamed, and unordered tokens with occurrence counts
Open the mismatched target line in source mode from the report
Extend the grammar with dollar-brace placeholders (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a translation tool; it only audits placeholder tokens in translation pairs you already have, and does not judge translation quality.
extras: Freemium: core pair check is free; folder pairs and dollar-brace grammar are Pro-gated behind a GitHub Sponsors payment. After minor or major updates the plugin opens a promotional 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off in settings). Explicit list of untested scenarios (mobile devices, Linux, large catalogs, concurrent edits) is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no way to check that translated strings keep the same placeholders (counts, names, types, order) as their source lines.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Placeholder auditor that compares named braces and printf tokens between source and translated note pairs and reports mismatches.
